questions.prompt: Why can friendly access reveal more than open hostility in this chapter?
choices: Because hostility never produces any information at all
Because all friendship is secretly false
Because people lower their guard more when they do not feel openly pressured

explanation.direct: People often disclose more in ordinary contact than they would under visible opposition.
explanation.competitive: Right. The room leaks more when it stops bracing.

The moment when people stop guarding details because the interaction feels ordinary and safe enough
A sign that direct interrogation is now required

explanation.gentle: Correct. Lowered vigilance is the relaxed state that makes ordinary disclosure easier.
explanation.direct: The chapter depends on people speaking more freely because they do not yet feel threatened.
explanation.competitive: Exactly. The shield drops before the details walk out.
